name: Mucknixer
description: They are different from their brothers in look. It is commonly thought that these creatures arise from the bodies of those who drown in shallow water: lost travelers falling into bogs, children who swim too far from the shore.
story: Mucknixer is the name given by humans to a dangerous species of drowner and drowned dead.
lore: This opinion is as widespread as it is false, for the beasts are in fact another post-Conjunction relic.
habitat: Battlefields, graveyards, marshes, and corpse-strewn ruins
